name: Import
description: Import files into Ledger: from your browser (the Send to Ledger extension, included), from email (Ledger's mailbox), from a scanner, from a phone's camera, or uploaded. PDFs and scans are filed in Ledger's Documents. Check them, read them with AI (you approve what it found), and send them on to Auto sort, other modules or Ledger's CSV import.

fields.label: Delete sent and archived files after (days)
fields.help: 0 keeps them until you delete them. Files waiting in the inbox are never deleted automatically.

fields.label: Read email

options.label: In the main books; not in other organizations

fields.help: Set per organization. The mailbox is the one connected under Settings → Mail (IMAP, e.g. Proton Mail Bridge, or Gmail); an admin allows Import to read mail there. If the Auto sort module reads the same mailbox for bills, turn its email off (Settings → Auto sort) and send the files from here instead.

fields.label: Check email every (minutes)
fields.help: 0 turns scheduled checks off; Check email now on the Import page always works.

fields.label: Keywords
fields.default: invoice, bill, statement, amount due, balance due, payment due, due date, receipt, pre-authorized, autopay, facture
fields.help: Comma-separated. Only emails containing one of these are imported. Empty: every email.

fields.label: Save matching emails without attachments as .eml files
fields.help: For bills sent as the email itself; Auto sort reads .eml bills.

fields.label: Network scanner
fields.help: Easiest from the Scan tab (Find scanners). Or its address, e.g. 192.168.1.40 or http://scanner.local/eSCL: a scanner or printer with AirScan / eSCL on your local network.
